purpose: Test whether human-reviewed real training crops improve a fixed HOG324 classifier on unchanged development candidates. Do not patch individual validation frames with geometry or thresholds.

frozen_choices.input: 32x32, FPGA grayscale and stride5 analysis path, existing nearest-neighbor stretch
frozen_choices.features: existing OpenCV HOG324 diagnostic descriptor; not integer HOG
frozen_choices.scaler: fit only on each experiment's training inputs; fold into linear weights and bias
frozen_choices.comparison: existing frozen model versus one candidate-adapted binary fit
frozen_choices.candidate_pipeline: existing min_run2, min_area16, top4; no joint candidate or threshold changes
frozen_choices.threshold: binary decision at zero only; no rejection threshold optimization

data_gates: Preserve original annotations, explicit human confirmation, frames, boxes, ROI hashes and reviewer/time receipts.
Obtain provenance/license and confirm scene/family separation for proposed training clip 3785878; source hash difference alone does not prove independent scene lineage.
Use only existing audited train360 plus confirmed ped/vehicle, crop_usable=yes crops from designated training scenes; exclude merged/uncertain and all validation material.
Apply per-track temporal thinning and exact-pixel duplicate checks. Geometry tracks are not human identity ground truth.
Do not count multiple crop variants of one target/time group as independent evidence; freeze the sample manifest and weighting before fitting.
Keep original ped/vehicle semantics separate from crop usability. Riders remain ignore and do not become background negatives.
All new samples and frame annotations stay pending until the user completes review. No AI prelabels become human truth.

inputs: Confirmed local2415171 32-frame moving-target set, unchanged, no training reuse
reports: By scene, class, human track and visibility: raw numerators/denominators
GT crop classification separately from matched-candidate classification and end-to-end recall
Paired fixes and regressions, including the three known flips without tuning specifically to them
Float/quantized label and score differences, product/accumulator bounds
Invalid FAR only if an independently confirmed invalid evaluation set exists; otherwise null
evaluation.limitation: Even perfect classification cannot exceed unchanged candidate localization coverage. This trial does not certify complete target detection.

later_rejection_heads.gate: At least two distinct training scenes with reviewed invalid target/time groups, enough valid positives, and independently reviewed evaluation negatives; then preregister a separate fixed comparison.
later_rejection_heads.rule: Do not quietly add a validity gate or train on current validation invalid samples.
